title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CommunityRequests Extension, specifically in versions 1.46 and 1.47. The issue is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the file includes/EntityDataRenderer.php. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with low privileges and user interaction to execute malicious scripts in the context of a victim's browser. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
